name: m38-hindi-tts-probe-texts
description: M38 fixed Hindi TTS evaluation set. Reuses the M32 hi/mixed probes VERBATIM (ids kept, sources preserved) for cross-milestone comparability, and adds M38-authored probes for the spec categories M32 did not cover: exclamation, Devanagari numerals, percentages, phone numbers, times, slash-dates, place names, org/product names, abbreviations, technical terminology, and a Hindi long-text ladder (~120/300/700/1200/2000 chars). Research instrument only: NOT an evaluation-plane corpus; if any category graduates it enters ml/evaluation/tts/corpora through the normal freeze.

provenance.author: IntelliAI (in-house)
provenance.source: tts-eval-seed@v1 + m32 probe-texts-v1.json (verbatim subset) + M38 original authorship (spec examples included verbatim from the M38 spec)
